snippet.title: Truer than You - Launch trailer
snippet.description:
Truer than You is about the search for meaning in a conformist society - set in a microcosm where commodified relationships, tech bros, climate activists, bored housewives and undercover artists are all in the mixture.

The androgyne main character Rin arrives in an unfamiliar city, to start their new position at a secretive company that rents out actors for real life situations. This is the start of a new life, far away from the daily struggles at Rin’s home on a small island. But as Rin gets on with their new endeavours, their past is catching up with them, and they’ll have to deal with who they are and will become.

❤ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161830/Truer_than_You/ 
❤ Itch: https://transcenders.itch.io/truer-than-you
